answers.core: Consistency between nodes is important and this proposal is a core API change.
answers.workaround: You can get around it by using `get_node(get_external_skeleton()` in a `BoneAttachment3D` script, however the path is relative so if you're referencing your attachment and do something like `get_node(attachment.get_external_skeleton())` from some other node on a different level, you'll get an error. It's not as convenient as just having a built-in method as `SkeletonModifier3D` has.
